name: Exploration
summary: The exploration chart for the plague-ridden city of Mousillon. Every multiple of 6 is a Special result, read off the district the battle was fought in.

places.name: Ruined Hovels
places.rules:
A ramshackle building falls on one of your Heroes. Choose a Hero and make an Initiative check. If you roll equal to or under his Initiative he is unharmed; otherwise he takes a wound. Roll for the injury even if the character has more wounds:
1-2 Wounded in the leg: next game M-1
3-4 Wounded in the arm: next game WS-1
5-6 Only sore muscles; no effect
Either way you find a small chest in the ruins and 2D6 gc inside it.

places.name: Rain Barrel
places.rules: Choose one of your Heroes and roll a D6. If the result is equal to or lower than his Toughness he finds a jewelled ring worth 15 gc at the bottom of the barrel. If he fails he has drunk from the barrel and must miss the next game through sickness, and the shiny thing turns out to be worthless.

places.name: Backpack
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what is inside:
1 A stale biscuit; nothing gained
2 Dagger
3 Helmet
4 Hammer
5 Axe
6 Suit of light armour

places.name: Beggar
places.rules:
Skaven warbands can sell the survivor to the agents of Clan Pestilens for 2D6 gc.
Any chaos-tainted warband can sacrifice him and the warband leader gains +1 Experience. Maldred's Disciples may only do this if his knights have come to his side; otherwise he takes the last option.
Undead warbands can kill him and gain a skeleton or zombie at no cost.
Any other warband can give him rations worth 1 gc and learn about treasure in the city: next time you roll on the exploration chart, roll one more dice than usual and discard any one dice (with three Heroes, roll four dice and pick any three).

places.name: Abandoned Shop
places.rules: After a thorough search you find loot worth D6 gc. If you roll a 1 you also find a Lucky Charm.

places.name: Special
places.rules:
Consult the result for the battle's location.
WESTERN APPROACH: Appoint a Hero to take a ring from a hollow tree. Add together his Initiative and Weapon Skill; if you roll lower than that total on 2D6 he snatches the ring, worth 10 gc when sold. If you fail, the ring disappears into the tree.
THE RIVER FRONT: If you pay a beggar 1 gc you may re-roll one exploration die next exploration phase.
THE MARSHES: One of your Heroes is pulled down at the edge of a bog. He makes 1 attack (5+ to hit, 4+ to wound); if he wounds he hacks off a tentacle and the blood coats his weapon for the next battle, counting as black lotus.
THE MAIN WHARF: If you buy any rare item you haggle the price down: deduct 2D6 gc from the price of the item.
NOBLE DISTRICT: Roll a D6: 1-5 Toughened Leathers, 6 a set of Cathayan silk clothes.
PALACE DISTRICT: The warband leader causes fear for the next battle.

places.name: Tavern
places.rules: The warband's leader must take a Leadership test. If he passes, the warband gains 4D6+6 gc worth of wines and ales, which can be sold immediately. If he fails, only D6 gc worth of alcohol is left when the warband reaches its encampment. Undead, Knights-Errant, Witch Hunter, Sisters of Sigmar and Wood Elf warbands pass this test automatically.

places.name: Old Armory
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1 Sword
2 Double-handed sword
3 Flail
4 D3 halberds
5 Lance
6 2D6 gc worth of metal, added to your treasury

places.name: Fletcher
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1 2D3 short bows
3 D3 bows
4 D3 long bows
5 Quiver of hunting arrows
6 D3 crossbows

places.name: The Mint
places.rules: Sweeping up the gold dust gives you 2D6+6 gc.

places.name: Prisoners
places.rules:
Chaos-orientated warbands can sacrifice the prisoners and gain D3 Experience, distributed amongst the Heroes.
Undead warbands can kill them and gain D3 skeletons or zombies at no cost.
Skaven can sell them into slavery for 3D6 gc.
Any other warband can escort them out of the city and is rewarded with 2D6 gc. In addition one of the prisoners asks to join: if you can afford to equip him, add a new henchman to any of your human henchman groups, with the same characteristics as the rest of the group even if they have already gained experience.

places.name: Special
places.rules:
Consult the result for the battle's location.
WESTERN APPROACH: You may use a Hired Sword with no hire fee (upkeep still applies): choose a Gladiator (pit fighter rules), a Witch or a Halfling Scout.
THE RIVER FRONT: You find a saviour ring, which allows one re-roll of a drowned result and lets its carrier cross water at normal movement.
THE MARSHES: You find a bony plate armour that counts as light armour and a shield.
THE MAIN WHARF: You find a jewel case whose contents sell for 3D6 gc.
NOBLE DISTRICT: You find a bottle of Elven Wine, enough for 4 warriors.
PALACE DISTRICT: You gain the free use of an Ogre Bodyguard for one battle. To keep him you must pay his upkeep; otherwise he leaves.

places.name: A Strange Dwarf
places.rules:
Randomly determine which Hero opens the strongbox; he loses one of his weapons, determined randomly but excluding the free dagger and magic items. Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1 Blunderbuss
2 Brace of pistols
3 Brace of duelling pistols
4 D3 handguns
5 D3 flasks of superior black powder
6 Hochland long rifle

places.name: Laboratory
places.rules:
Your warband may strip the alchemist's laboratory and gain 2D6 gc worth of loot.
Chaos, Skaven and Brigand warbands recognise some of the materials and know a buyer: they gain 3D6 gc from their patrons, and one of their weapons (chosen by the player) counts as permanently poisoned and always wounds automatically when a 6 is rolled to hit, as black lotus does. Undead and Possessed models are immune to this effect.

places.name: Death Pit
places.rules:
Any warband apart from Knights-Errant and the Bretonnian Hunting Party may loot the corpses and gains D6x10 gc worth of loot. If you loot the pit, the next time you play the Blood Dragons, the Bretonnian Hunting Party or the Knights-Errant, the entire enemy warband hates every model in your warband. Note it on your roster.
The Knights-Errant and the Bretonnian Hunting Party instead clean up the graveyard and are rewarded with D6 Experience, distributed amongst the Heroes. A Blood Dragon warband gains D3 skeletons and may distribute D3 Experience amongst its Heroes.

places.name: Armorer
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1-2 D3+1 shields or bucklers (choose which)
3 D3 helmets
4 D3 suits of light armour
5 D3 suits of heavy armour
6 Suit of Ithilmar armour

places.name: Sewers
places.rules: You may use the tunnels in the next battle you play. Position up to three fighters (no large creatures) anywhere on the battlefield at ground level. They are set up at the end of the player's first turn and cannot be placed within 8" of any enemy model.

places.name: Special
places.rules:
Consult the result for the battle's location.
WESTERN APPROACH: A sage charges you 5 gc and tells you the seashell is worth 35 gc. Kept as an amulet, all animals that want to attack its bearer must first pass a Leadership test.
THE RIVER FRONT: You find a colony of river lobsters: you may count your warband as having 1-3 members when selling loot.
THE MARSHES: All warbands except Skaven may destroy the ratmen's shrine and gain D3+1 Experience, distributed freely. A Skaven warband may honour the Horned Rat instead: roll 2D6 for the Skaven leader. 2-3 you lose 2 random warband members (they count as going out of action; roll on the serious injury table if necessary). 4-7 nothing happens. 8-10 the leader gains Tail Fighting as a skill, or an extra attack if he already has it. 11-12 the leader gains the Black Hunger skill, but with a 4+ save against the wounds it does.
THE MAIN WHARF: In a stranded wreck you find an unplundered armoury. Roll a D6 for each line:
2 suits of light armour 5+
3 boathooks (spears) 4+
D3+1 shields 4+
Gold crested breastplate (gromril armour) 6+
A jewelled helmet, which can be sold for 320 gc 5+
NOBLE DISTRICT: You corner a female vampire (normal stats, sword and dagger, heavy armour). You may run, or select a fighter to fight her; roll a D6 for who charges. If your character loses he gains 1 Experience and 25 gc, which the vampire drops as she escapes; any out of action result requires a roll on the serious injury table. If he wins he gains 3 Experience, 25 gc and the equipment she carries.
PALACE DISTRICT: Behind a secret door you find a crypt and the staked victim's silver breastplate: it is Ithilmar armour.

places.name: A Healer
places.rules: You may re-roll the serious injury roll of one of your Heroes who is still alive, no matter how long ago the injury was sustained. If you also pay the healer 30 gc you may ignore death results on the new roll.

places.name: Crumbled Tower
places.rules:
Roll a D6:
1-2 3D6 gc and a scroll of Silver Arrows of Ahra. A Hero may read the scroll in one of his shooting phases and cast the spell if he passes the difficulty roll; one use only. A spellcaster may read it and gains +2 on the difficulty roll if he already knows the spell.
3-4 A wizard's cloak: its wearer gets a 6+ armour save (not cumulative with light or heavy armour) and is -1 to be shot at. Worn by a spellcaster the save is 5+. The cloak does not prohibit the use of magic.
5-6 A magician's tome, which can only be used once. Roll a D6: on a 5+ you may learn lesser magic spells when you gain a skill advance; otherwise you gain a 5+ save against spells.

places.name: The Gatehouse
places.rules: Roll 2D6x5 gc. If you roll a double you also find a Wheel amulet, the symbol of the merchant guild, which lets you use the Haggle skill from now on.

places.name: Glowing Pool
places.rules:
Choose which Hero steps forward and take a Leadership test. If he passes, the war dog yields to him and he gains a war dog. If he fails he must fight the war dog: roll to see who charges; the fight lasts 2 rounds, after which the rest of the warband steps in and the dog flees.
In the pool you find a strange glowing stone. You may sell it for D3x15 gc or keep it, in which case it allows 1 re-roll on the serious injury chart.

places.name: The Mapmaker
places.rules: A detailed map of Mousillon. It allows you to modify 1 exploration die by +1/-1. If you use it, no other +1/-1 modifications are allowed while in Mousillon.

places.name: Special
places.rules:
Consult the result for the battle's location.
WESTERN APPROACH: In a fortified room you find a strong box with D6x10 gc in it and a blunderbuss.
THE RIVER FRONT: You gain the use of an Imperial Assassin (with a crossbow instead of throwing knives) for one battle, after which upkeep is necessary.
THE MARSHES: You find a pair of weeping blades. The first character to touch them (you choose) learns Weapons Training and can use the blades.
THE MAIN WHARF: You find two barrels of Bugman's beer.
NOBLE DISTRICT: You find a book on swordsmanship and 2 rapiers. You may sell the book for 100 gc or let one Hero read it: he may use all swords from now on (as the Weapons Training skill) and may parry with them on an equal or higher die roll, and his racial maximum Weapon Skill is raised by 1.
PALACE DISTRICT: You find a suit of Gromril armour.

places.name: Maldred's Castle
places.rules: If you wish, send one of your Heroes to search the castle for treasure and roll a D6. On a 1 the Hero is devoured by unseen creatures and never seen again. On a 2 or more he returns with D6+1x20 gc worth of jewels.

places.name: The Treasure Room
places.rules:
Roll for every item on the list separately, apart from the gold coins, to see whether you find it:
3D6x5 gc Auto
Holy relic 5+
Suit of heavy armour 5+
D3 gems worth 10 gc each 4+
D3 pieces of jewellery worth 20 gc each 5+
Elven cloak 5+
Holy tome 5+
Magical artefact 5+

places.name: Dwarven Secret Stash
places.rules:
Roll a D6 to see what you find:
1 D3 double-handed axes
2 D3 suits of heavy armour
3 Gromril axe
4 Gromril hammer
5 Double-handed gromril axe
6 Gromril armour

places.name: The Eating Hall
places.rules:
Roll for every item separately to see if you find it:
3D6x5 gc Auto
D3 suits of light armour 4+
Suit of gromril armour 5+
Suit of heavy armour 4+
Mousillon map 4+
D3 halberds 5+
D3 swords 3+
D3 shields 2+
D3 bows 4+
D3 helmets 2+
Brace of duelling pistols 4+

places.name: Audience Room
places.rules: Roll a D6. On a 1-2 you find D6x10 gc worth of items and money to add to your treasury. On a 3-4 you find D6 vials of Crimson Shade. On a 5-6 you find a hidden magical artefact: roll on the Magical Artefacts table.

places.name: Special
places.rules:
Consult the result for the battle's location.
WESTERN APPROACH: You find a Lady's Mirror. Roll a D6: on a 1-4 it counts as a full Mousillon map; on a 5-6 it is fully functional: no one can hide within 12" of the character carrying it, anyone aiming at the carrier has an extra -1 to hit, and its owner may roll 2 exploration dice and pick one of them if he did not go out of action.
THE RIVER FRONT: An old peddler offers a game of chance. You may roll the die or not; if you roll a D6: on a 1 your warband leader loses a random item; on a 3-5 all his armour and weapons become jewelled, doubling their worth (a jewelled sword costs 20 gc); on a 6 you may roll on the Magical Artefacts table.
THE MARSHES: A non-Skaven warband may destroy the Skaven and his hut, gaining D6x10 gc and D6 Experience to distribute in the warband. A Skaven warband may consult the seer: roll a D6; on a 1-4 all the warband's weapons count as coated with black lotus for the next battle, and on a 5+ they may roll on the Magical Artefacts table.
THE MAIN WHARF: Following directions found on a wine cask, roll a D6 for each item separately:
D3 suits of heavy armour 5+
D3 duelling pistols 5+
D6x10 gc Auto
A brace of warplocks 5+
A blunderbuss 4+
Magical artefact 6+
NOBLE DISTRICT: Decide which character sits in the leather chair, then roll a D6: on a 1 he is burned and must roll on the serious injury table; on a 2-4 you gain gold crowns equal to half the warband rating, rounding down; on a 6 you may roll on the Magical Artefacts table.
PALACE DISTRICT: Select a character to drink from the goblet. A character tainted by chaos gains chaos armour. An evil character (Skaven, undead and so on) may roll on the Magical Artefacts table, but finds nothing on a 6. Any other character rolls a D6: on a 1-3 he is killed outright and removed from the warband list; on a 4+ he may roll on the Magical Artefacts table.
